result.title: In-context learning of solution to simple linear regression task using transformer with masked linear self-attention
result.summary: In-context learning is a remarkable property of transformers and has recently received a lot of interest. In many studies of in-context learning, it has been shown that transformers are capable of implementing solvers for linear and non-linear regression problems, in which the most of them implement gradient descent algorithm. However, it is still unclear whether those implementations have actually been acquired through training. In this paper, we constructed a transformer with masked linear self-attention, which in-context learns the least squares estimate in a simple regression task. The point here is that the closed form (analytical) solution is obtained by using layer normalization rather than an approximate solution based on the gradient descent algorithm. Then, we showed an experimental example, in which, by taking the non-uniqueness of the transformer representation into account, our implementation for a closed form solution is used in the transformer trained with the l1 regularization when the target output is the least squares estimate.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构造带 masked linear self-attention 的 transformer，借助 layer normalization 在简单线性回归的 in-context learning 中实现最小二乘的闭式解，而非梯度下降近似，并讨论表示非唯一性下训练所得模型与该构造的对应关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于「训练是否真正获得所构造算法」及表示非唯一性的讨论，可能为核查 LVR 的 latent 状态是否实际承载预期计算、以及 latent 相似度结果应如何解释提供启发，但跨任务迁移性尚待核查。
